sections.text_helper: Section 25.6.1 "EXTI register security protection" in chapter 25 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1133.
sections.section_content:
When security is enabled for an input event, the associated input event configuration and
the control bits can only be modified and read by a secure access. A nonsecure write
access is discarded and a read returns 0.
When input events are nonsecure, the security is disabled. The associated input event
configuration and control bits can be modified and read by a secure access and nonsecure
access.
The security configuration in EXTI_SECCFGRx can be globally locked after reset by
GLOCK in EXTI_LOCKR.
Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)
